name: install
command: bash scripts/install.sh

name: hardware-host
command:
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,pci.bus_id --format=csv,noheader
ls -l /dev/nvidia* /dev/dri
cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version
lspci -nnk -d 10de:
if command -v vulkaninfo; then vulkaninfo --summary; else echo "vulkaninfo unavailable; real task construction is decisive"; fi

name: install-host
command: bash scripts/install.sh

name: preflight
command: uv run python scripts/preflight.py --output results/local-20261110-d4/preflight/hardware.json

name: baseline-lint
command: uv run ruff check src scripts tests

name: baseline-format
command: uv run ruff format --check src scripts tests

name: baseline-tests
command: uv run pytest -q

name: push-smoke-01
command: timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=15s 5m uv run python scripts/qualify.py --task PushCube-v1 --states 1 --output results/local-20261110-d4/push-smoke-01
